items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: I remember Tom Anderson I remember all about Down there on Burbins

ctx.x: Charles Young Charles Young's Cabaret I think it was just called Cabaret Limited

I don't remember him I remember I remember Tom Anderson I remember all about Down there on Burbins I mean down there About Lula White And all that Around Basin Street All that And all that Was blue Because
You ever played Any of those places?

items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: Yeah, the Tom Anderson Cabaret. He hung around there, huh? Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up.

ctx.x: Here's some more. Where did Rabbit sing Downfall of the Lion?

Yeah, the Tom Anderson Cabaret. He hung around there, huh? Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up. And he made up another song about Gypsy Blood, the time they had all that killing down there. He had several little songs right there.
You mean Billy Phillips and that Parker fella that got killed?
